prompts: An integration test of the Pixel Arena backend in {WS} fails while the unit tests pass. Make the backend behave as {WS}/docs says: fix every cause, not just the symptom this test shows. Existing tests stay as they are, and the project takes no new dependencies.
answers:
[goal] Make the Pixel Arena backend behave as ./docs says; fix root causes behind the failing integration test.

[action] Two root causes found and fixed:
- `arena_server/config/loader.py` — env vars were applied before the JSON file, so the file overrode env, inverting the documented precedence (docs/CONFIG.md: DEFAULTS < JSON file < env, "the environment always wins"). Reordered: file first, env last.
- `arena_server/persistence/codec.py` — `decode` dropped `credits` when reloading a profile (docs/ECONOMY.md: "Credits persist in the profile and survive save/load"), so any save/load reset credits to 0. `decode` now restores `credits` (default 0 for old files).

[result] Assumption: no other docs constraints exist (only CONFIG.md and ECONOMY.md present). Verified: `python -m unittest discover -s tests` → "Ran 13 tests ... OK" — the integration test `test_event_weekend_win_is_paid_and_persisted` passes (env kill_bonus=75 beats file's 50: (900+5×75)×1.25=1593.75 → 1590) and all 12 existing unit tests still pass. Payout rounding was already correct (floor(x/10+0.5) rounds halves up as specified). No browser tabs or apps were opened, so nothing to close.

[how I know it is right] Test output above: 13/13 OK after the two edits; each fix maps to an explicit sentence in the docs.
